faqs.q: My garage shares a wall with my bedroom in my Skokie home. Which opener is best for noise?
faqs.a: For Skokie homes where the garage is attached and shares a wall with a living space, like many properties in Downtown Skokie or Timber Ridge, a belt-drive opener is the quietest option. Belt-drive models use a rubber belt instead of a metal chain, which significantly reduces noise and vibration. This can make a big difference for comfort, especially if your current opener is old and loud. Our technicians can discuss these options and help you choose the best fit for your home's layout and your preference for quiet operation.

faqs.q: Can you install smart features, like MyQ, on my Skokie garage door opener?

This allows you to control your garage door from your smartphone, receive alerts, and even grant access remotely. Many newer belt-drive and wall-mount openers come with these features. Upgrading to a smart opener adds convenience and security, which is a popular choice for modernizing the older garage systems common in Skokie's housing stock.
